test_title: PYST 32: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate active form of the given sentence.**

The movie was directed by the famous filmmaker and produced by the studio.

options.text: The famous filmmaker directed the movie and the studio produced it.
The movie was being directed by the famous filmmaker and produced by the studio.
The movie was directed and produced by the famous filmmaker and the studio.
The famous filmmaker and the studio collaborated to make the movie.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The famous filmmaker directed the movie and the studio produced it.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this passive sentence, the focus is on the movie, and the actions of directing and producing are being done to it.
 
• The structure is: Subject + Verb (Past Participle) + Agent__.
 __
 
• **Subject**: The movie
 
• **Verb**: was directed, produced
 
• **Past Participle**: directed, produced
 
• **Agent**: by the famous filmmaker, by the studio
 
 
 
• In the active voice, the focus is on the doer of the actions, which makes the sentence more direct and concise.
 
• The structure is: Subject + Verb + Object.__
 
 
• **Subject**: The famous filmmaker, The studio
 
• **Verb**: directed, produced
 
• **Object**: the movie
 
 
 
• In the active voice, the sentence becomes clearer, and the doers of the actions are explicitly stated at the beginning of each clause. 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.
